catalog.name: EMBER
catalog.browseRule: Sling a spark up a dark flue. Every launch spends a glow; the damp below never stops.
catalog.rule: Drag back and release to sling a living spark up the flue. Ledges refill your launches, soot-moths refund one mid-air, and stringing launches through open air builds a chain that pays when you land.
catalog.tension: Glow is currency. The safe ledges pay it back; the treasure and the chains live where they can't.
catalog.publicNarrative:
Drag back and release to sling a living spark up the flue. Ledges refill your launches, soot-moths refund one mid-air, and stringing launches through open air builds a chain that pays when you land.

Glow is currency. The safe ledges pay it back; the treasure and the chains live where they can't.

One finger or mouse button

catalog.name: DELVE
catalog.browseRule: Dig deep against the clock. Momentum is a promise you can't take back.
catalog.rule: Drive a digging machine down a winding corridor, sweep time fragments to keep the run alive, and dodge the rocks. Speed builds depth but carries momentum: the machine turns wide and stops slow, and a rare power item turns a hopeless field around.
catalog.tension: The defining moment is full throttle into a gap you're no longer sure you can make. Ease off at the right instant and the tight line pays; hold it a beat too long and the corridor collects.
catalog.inputSummary: One thumb, a mouse, or two keys
catalog.publicNarrative:

One thumb, a mouse, or two keys

catalog.name: STOMP
catalog.browseRule: Keep one ball in play against a draining clock. Stomp walkers, strike flyers from above.
catalog.rule: Slide the machine under the returning ball and jump: a grounded catch bounces it steady, a rising catch launches it high enough to strike the flyers above. Three clean top hits burst an enemy into time, and a slow first target always drifts in low to get you started.
catalog.tension: The high launch reaches the richest targets, but a higher ball stays away longer and its underside contact bites. Safe returns alone lose to the clock.
catalog.inputSummary: Two thumbs, a mouse, or three keys
